commit_message:
Fix misuse of MediaProvider#INCLUDED_DEFAULT_DIRECTORIES

MediaProvider#INCLUDED_DEFAULT_DIRECTORIES is internally used to grant
access for file rename based on relative path. It can be misused by
setting it in the bundle. Updated the code to stop using this extra and
stope respecting it in AccessChecker class.

Test: atest MediaProviderTests
